# PH's AIxArchviz FLUX2.k9b x LTX2.3 Series: ALL-IN-ONE

*An all-in-one workflow bundle combining image generation, image editing, and camera-controlled image-to-video generation.*

Showcase: [Youtube Video Walkthrough](https://youtu.be/6aXJqRhjXo0)
___
## Support, feedback, suggestions and improvements highly appreciated ❤️
- comfycloud: [ComfyCloud](https://cloud.comfy.org/?via=ph01) (affiliate link, i may earn a commission)
- Web: [paulhansen.de](https://www.paulhansen.de)
- Instagram: [paulhansen.design](https://www.instagram.com/paulhansen.design/)
- LinkedIn: [Paul Hansen](https://www.linked.com/in/ph3d)
- Discord: [PH's AIxArchviz Discord](https://discord.gg/3UW5ZaWpWq)
- Ko-Fi: [ko-fi/paulhansen](https://www.ko-fi.com/paulhansen)

___
## HOW TO USE THESE WORKFLOWS

### **STAGE I** - FLUX2.k9b: IMAGE GENERATE
Make sure all models used in this workflow are available on your device (including correct folder placement). Load **1 OR 2 images for VISUAL GUIDANCE** (depth, canny, normals, sketches, lineart, skribble, ...) with up to 4 megapixel (2048×2048) resolution in the LOAD IMAGE (image 1/image 2) nodes as a starting point for your generations, set USE 2 INPUT IMAGES accordingly, then define your prompt e.g. "masterpiece architecture photography of a black wood tinyhouse entirely made of straight vertical black wood panels, (...)". TXT2IMG overrides the input images to let you create visual assets to be used e.g. as references for IMAGE EDIT.

### **STAGE II** - FLUX2.k9b: IMAGE EDIT
Make sure all models used in this workflow are available on your device (including correct folder placement). Load any image in the LOAD IMAGE (image 1) node as a starting point for your edits, load any REFERENCE IMAGE (image 2) for using its content during editing. Refer to the images in your prompt, e.g. "add the flamingo from image 2 to stand on the summer meadow in image 1 bright sunlight". Either use an RGB IMAGE, Mask Editor or a Prompt in "AUTOMASK BY PROMPT" to create your mask for the editing. For smoother results increase SOFTEN MASK value. **Note that SEPARATE MASK COMPONENTS works best with values below 5 for SOFTEN MASK feature.** Use Auto-enhance, -remove or -outpaint according to your needs.

### **STAGE III** -LTX2.3: CAMCONTROLLED IMAGE 2 VIDEO
*(cc-by-sa 4.0)*

Make sure all models used in this workflow are available on your device (including correct folder placement). Load any image in the LOAD IMAGE node as a starting frame for your video generation, load any video as a reference for the camera animation in the LOAD VIDEO node and hit RUN. Note that aspect ratio will be adopted from the LOAD IMAGE input, depending on your resolution there might be some cropping to match best working video settings (resolutions should be divisible by 32).

___
### Custom Nodes:

- [ComfyUI-KJNodes by Kijai](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
- [ComfyUI_essentials by Matteo](https://github.com/cubiq/ComfyUI_essentials)
- [masquerade nodes by BadCafeCode](https://github.com/BadCafeCode/masquerade-nodes-comfyui)
- [LanPaint by scraed](https://github.com/scraed/LanPaint)
- [Inpaint Crop & Stitch by lquesada](https://github.com/lquesada/ComfyUI-Inpaint-CropAndStitch)
- [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite by Kosinkadink](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite)


*For installation, use the ComfyUI-Manager or find the terminal commands in the respective repository, e.g. `git clone https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes` executed in `<YOUR_PATH_TO_COMFYUI>/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/`* 
___
